d:
Who is Direwolf? Our third ongoing comic! And yes, it is indeed a #Bodyswap! Alex Lucien is DIREWOLF, crime fighter at night and billionaire playboy womanizer during the day.

https://ladyvaliantcomic.com/other-comics/direwolf/

His arch nemesis, APEX, and his daughter, Delia Disdain, also known as the deadly assassin Nightshade has been a thorn in his side for years. But unbeknownst to Alex and APEX, Delia has just been denied her inheritance; being passed over for her idiot brother simply because she is a woman.

Tired of being overlooked, she looks to become a man and directly challenge her father. But not just any man! She is eyeing Alex Lucien for his wealth, his good lucks, and his womanizing reputation, obsessed with becoming a man; becoming Alex, not knowing he is her arch nemesis Direwolf.

This twisted bodyswap promises to deliver in some brand-new thrills! Issue 2 should be finished this month! Check it out on the Super Partner Tier! Use code HALLOW to get 50% off the tier this month!
